errors.text_span: 在 Mathverse 任务中，DAPO+Self-reflection 的准确率约为56%，GRPO 约为53.5%，DAPO 约为53%，PPO+Self-reflection 约为54.5%，PPO 约为53.5%；在 MMLU 任务中，DAPO+Self-reflection 约为57%，GRPO 约为56%，DAPO 约为55.5%，PPO+Self-reflection 约为55%，PPO 约为54.5%；在 Physics 任务中，DAPO+Self-reflection 达到最高值约61%，GRPO 约为58.5%，DAPO 约为57.5%，PPO+Self-reflection 约为59%，PPO 约为57%。
errors.evidence: Several values are approximate but some are noticeably off or incomplete relative to the chart, especially because SRPO values are missing entirely and some reported bar heights (e.g., GRPO/PPO in multiple tasks) do not align closely with the plotted bars.

The description does not explicitly mention that the chart compares performance of various RL methods with and without self-reflection, which is indicated in the figure caption and visible by the grouped bars/legend.
The description omits one legend entry and its corresponding orange solid bar (SRPO), and therefore does not fully describe the six-series grouped structure shown in the legend and bars.

errors.text_span: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy (%) of five reinforcement learning (RL) methods—DAPO+Self-reflection (blue solid), GRPO (orange diagonal stripes), DAPO (blue diagonal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (green solid), and PPO (green diagonal stripes)—across three benchmark datasets: Mathverse, MMLU, and Physics.
errors.evidence: The figure has six methods in the legend, including SRPO (orange solid), which is missing from this list. The description also incorrectly omits SRPO from the method mapping.

errors.text_span: In Mathverse, DAPO+Self-reflection achieves approximately 56.5%, GRPO around 53.5%, DAPO about 53%, PPO+Self-reflection roughly 54.5%, and PPO approximately 53%.
errors.evidence: In Mathverse, DAPO+Self-reflection is about 56%, not 56.5%; PPO+Self-reflection is about 54.5% which is acceptable, but the omitted SRPO bar is around 55.8% and should be included.

errors.text_span: In MMLU, DAPO+Self-reflection reaches about 56.5%, GRPO around 55.5%, DAPO approximately 55.5%, PPO+Self-reflection about 55.5%, and PPO roughly 54.5%.
errors.evidence: The MMLU bars are approximately 56.9% (DAPO+Self-reflection), 55.8% (GRPO), 55.9% (DAPO), 56.2% (SRPO), 54.6% (PPO+Self-reflection), and 53.3% (PPO); the description omits SRPO and gives several values only roughly.

errors.text_span: In Physics, DAPO+Self-reflection attains the highest accuracy at approximately 61.5%, followed by SRPO (orange solid, not labeled in legend but visually consistent with GRPO’s pattern) at about 60.5%, DAPO at roughly 57.5%, PPO+Self-reflection at approximately 58.5%, and PPO at about 56.5%.
errors.evidence: The Physics group includes six bars, and the orange solid bar is SRPO, which is labeled in the legend; the chart also includes GRPO (orange diagonal stripes) and DAPO (blue diagonal stripes), which are omitted from this sentence. Additionally, DAPO+Self-reflection is about 61%, not 61.5%.

errors.text_span: The chart visually emphasizes that methods incorporating self-reflection (DAPO+Self-reflection, PPO+Self-reflection, and SRPO) generally outperform their non-reflection counterparts (DAPO, PPO, GRPO), with DAPO+Self-reflection achieving the highest performance across all three datasets, particularly in Physics.
errors.evidence: This is an unsupported interpretation and also factually misleading: DAPO+Self-reflection is not the highest in all three datasets, since in each group SRPO is higher than GRPO/DAPO/PPO but the chart does not establish a general rule beyond the bars shown; the claim that self-reflection methods generally outperform counterparts is not explicitly indicated by the chart and overstates the visual evidence.

The description fails to mention that there are six bars per category and that the legend includes SRPO (solid orange), DAPO+Self-reflection (solid blue), DAPO (blue diagonal stripes), GRPO (orange diagonal stripes), PPO+Self-reflection (solid green), and PPO (green diagonal stripes).
